name: Relio – AI Chat Assistant
author: Relio

sections.description:
Relio is an AI-powered chat assistant that helps your website engage visitors and convert them into customers through intelligent conversations and product recommendations.

This plugin connects your store to the Relio service, enabling:

  • AI Product Recommendations — Relio’s chatbot understands your product catalog and recommends the right products based on customer conversations.
  • Add to Cart from Chat — Customers can add recommended products directly to their WooCommerce cart without leaving the chat.
  • Order Tracking — Completed orders are reported to Relio for sales attribution, letting you see which conversations led to purchases.
  • Automatic Chat Widget — The Relio chat widget is automatically added to your store’s front-end. No code changes needed.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate this plugin.
  2. Click “Connect to Relio” to link your store.
  3. Sign up or log in at relio.chat.
  4. Approve the WooCommerce API connection.
  5. Your products sync automatically — the AI chatbot is ready.

All chatbot configuration (tone, design, product settings) is managed in the Relio dashboard at relio.chat.

Third-Party Service

This plugin connects to the Relio service (relio.chat) to provide AI chatbot functionality. By activating and connecting this plugin, your store data (product catalog, completed orders) is transmitted to Relio’s servers for processing.

  • Service URL: https://relio.chat
  • Terms of Service: https://relio.chat/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://relio.chat/privacy

Data transmitted includes:
* Product catalog (titles, descriptions, prices, images, URLs)
* Completed order details (total, products, customer email) for sales attribution
* Store URL for identification

No customer browsing data or personal information is collected by this plugin without the customer explicitly interacting with the chat widget.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Search for “Relio AI Chat Assistant”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to the Relio menu item in your admin sidebar.
  5. Click Connect to Relio and follow the prompts.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Go to Relio in your admin sidebar and click Connect to Relio.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Relio account?

Yes. This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to the Relio service. You can create a free account at relio.chat.

Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. This plugin is specifically built for WooCommerce stores and requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

What data is sent to Relio?

Your product catalog (for AI recommendations) and completed order data (for sales attribution). No personal customer data is collected without their explicit interaction with the chat widget.

Can I disconnect at any time?

Yes. Go to Relio → Settings and click Disconnect. Your WooCommerce store continues to work normally.

Where do I configure the chatbot?

All chatbot settings (tone, design, features, popup rules) are managed in the Relio dashboard at relio.chat. This plugin handles only the store connection.
sections.changelog:
1.2.3

  • Compatibility: Declared support for WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) and Cart/Checkout Blocks.
  • Compatibility: WC tested up to 9.8.

1.2.2

  • Compatibility: Tested up to WordPress 7.0.

1.2.1

  • Fixed: Widget script now loads correctly (site key passed as URL parameter).

1.2.0

  • Fixed: Chat widget now displays correctly after connecting via the plugin.
  • New: Site selector — switch between Relio sites directly from the plugin settings.
  • New: Settings page shows active chatbot name and domain.
  • Improved: Connection flow uses secure API keys instead of numeric IDs.

1.1.0

  • Self-hosted update mechanism for direct installs.
  • Improved connection detection for Relio-first setup flow.
  • Compatibility with WordPress 7.0 and WooCommerce 9.6.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • WooCommerce API connection via built-in auth.
  • Product catalog sync.
  • Order webhook for sales attribution.
  • Add-to-cart from chat.
  • Automatic chat widget injection.
